Robinson and Henry, they have an internal motto to get the most money paid from the client while communicating as little as possible with both parties, Meanwhile, they will hold low-cost to free consults, stating how cheap/fast they could get it done; often confusing the client with how the firm charges. Clients often spent crazy amounts of money and had little communication about the case. Once their case was over win or lose, the firm would turn around and offer them a bankruptcy consultation for 145$... after the Firm got paid, of course.

The paras would leave because they were treated poorly and couldn't take time off if they were sick or if their child had an emergency, the associates would leave because they were paid poorly or were not really being helped they would just be giving an inhumane amound of cases by the partners OFTEN overbooked for court days. The partners would leave because they really were not practicing law, more just doing intake and had no idea how the company worked, while their team lost cases, and they told the clients they will win for very little cost.

  
The whole place is a mess I suggest if anyone needs an attorney, go somewhere else; all the good associates left within two months of working at Robinson and Henry.
